response.body:
The releasedCDEsXML-OD is a zip that contains X number of XML files of the XML format.  Included in this format
are all the CDE's that are registration_status not like '%RETIRED%' and rep_conte_name not like '%TEST%' and rep_conte_name not like '%TRAINING%'.

This file is updated on a daily basis.

If you are looking for an older file you can look in the Archive folder for older files.
